independence: Own calculations from archived public Census tables only. No NYT estimates, poll responses, commercial voter files, party labels or candidate votes are inputs.

specification.training: k is the last three earlier elections of the same type; race starts in 2004.
specification.baseline: The group's turnout rate in the immediately previous election of the same type.
specification.target: Published CPS self-reported turnout among civilian noninstitutionalized adult citizens.
specification.scoring: Equal-weight group/election errors in percentage points; overlapping groups are not independent samples and are never summed into an electorate.
specification.thresholds: Working research criteria fixed before running this experiment, not a general statistical certification or a model-uncertainty interval.

checks.requirement: At least 10% lower mean absolute error than same-type carry-forward
Lower mean absolute error in both presidential and midterm tests
Lower mean absolute error in every demographic dimension
No worse mean absolute error in the latest held-out midterm
Mean absolute error no greater than 5 percentage points for every group

reasons: No complete, matched 2026 national demographic participation and population inputs.
No survey-design, measurement-error or model-uncertainty intervals have been fitted.
Historical persistence does not identify 2026 demographic turnout shifts.
Historical CPS targets are self-reported, not validated individual turnout.
Retrospective year holdouts use today's archived tables, not verified historical release vintages.
